name: activity.md
summary: Activity: incremental read of ACCESS_HISTORY, the Activity tab numbers, grant path behind a use, rules 24-28

name: Rule 24: Person changed data or a table's definition
summary: Medium. A person (in USER, not a service user) ran WRITE or DDL on a known object with a role that has no OWNERSHIP reach on it (data_use(role)[1][object] lacks "own"); one finding per user and object: statement counts, the most used role, last day. access.py:5168-5178

name: Rule 25: Service user used from an interactive client
summary: High. A service user (is_service) has activity rows whose CLIENT is in INTERACTIVE (Snowflake UI, SnowSQL, Snowflake CLI); one finding per service user: queries per client label, tables, last day. access.py:5163-5164,5192-5198

name: Rule 26: Admin role used to read or change data
summary: High. Activity rows whose ROLE_NAME is in ADMIN on a known object; one finding per user and admin role: objects read, objects changed (action not READ), first three names. access.py:5165-5166,5199-5203

name: Rule 27: First access to a table in the last 7 days
summary: Low. Per user and object: the first day on the object is within the last NEW_DAYS (7) days of the snapshot and the user had activity before cut - NEW_DAYS (not a new user); detail adds "sensitive" for tagged objects. access.py:5157,5179-5183

name: Rule 28: Unusual volume on a table
summary: Medium. Per user and object with at least 5 active days: the busiest day has >= SPIKE[1] (50) queries and more than SPIKE[0] (3) x the median day. access.py:5184-5191

name: Activity read window (incremental)
summary: Window = ACTIVITY_DAYS (60) back from now; rows of an earlier read are kept up to the day before its last day, and that day onwards is read again (ACCESS_HISTORY lags up to 3 hours). Same in SP_ACCESS_SNAPSHOT activity() (sql/1_setup.sql:568-576).

name: App's own queries left out of activity
summary: The app's connection sets QUERY_TAG 'access-explorer' (sf.py:34); activity_sql drops QUERY_HISTORY rows with that tag (access.py:945, sql/1_setup.sql:552).

name: Activity tab counts
summary: activity(name, what, user): queries per day over ACTIVITY_DAYS ending at the snapshot day, totals by user/role/client/statement/object split into read/write/ddl, one row per user+role+client+object+statement+action; counts are per action, so a MERGE that reads and changes a table counts twice.

name: Grant path behind a use
summary: used_path(user, role, object, action): user -> shortest chain to the role used -> shortest data_use chain to a holder of a privilege that fits the action (READ_PRIVS for READ, else WRITE_PRIVS or OWNERSHIP) -> object; None when the role reaches no such grant now (admin role, grant gone).

name: ACTIVITY_DAYS
summary: Days of table activity read and shown (env ACTIVITY_DAYS, default 60)

name: QUERY_TAG
summary: Query tag of the app's own connection, 'access-explorer'

name: INTERACTIVE
summary: Clients where people type queries (env INTERACTIVE_CLIENTS; default Snowflake UI, SnowSQL, Snowflake CLI); rule 25

name: CLIENTS
summary: SESSIONS client id (version cut) -> short label (Snowflake UI -> Snowsight, PythonConnector -> Python, ...)

name: SPIKE
summary: Rule 28 thresholds: (3 x the median day, at least 50 queries)

name: NEW_DAYS
summary: Rule 27: first access within the last 7 days

name: MAX_ACTIVITY
summary: Rows of the Activity table sent (500); counts cover all rows
